coincided with the DecCa arrangement or not. I'm not sure. But I was still being handled by that office, you know. And of course the Gale Agency, I was contacted, MCA was contacted from the Gale Agency and I think that, I'm trying to think, I think Lew Leslie at the time was connected with the Gale Agency. Lew Leslie was a former producer of some of the early shows. You know, "Black Birds" and things like that. And so he was more familiar with the areas where these types of bands would be excepted. And so I had…

Okay. I've just been looking through the entry under Benny Carter's name and Brian Rust's and it confirms what I have written down in my notes here is that you recorded with Benny Carter on the 1st of April in 1941. So it's possible that the tour which came later in the year followed as a result of the success of that recording session.
